correctness.rationale: For each \(n\ge1\), centrality against rank-one partial identities forbids any moved arrow. Conjugacy by the permutation group forces entire \(E_r\) orbits. Restriction counts show every \(E_r\) commutes with all partial bijections. Intersection sizes produce the exact rank-set law, rank decrement classifies idempotents, and the intersection-size interval proves \(A^n=A^{n+1}\) sharply at \(E_{n-1}\). Direct independent Python enumeration of complete multiplication tables (\(n=1,2,3\)) and rank-index checks (\(1\le n\le9\)) returned VERIFY_OK; finite computations are corroboration, not an infinite proof. Unproved limits: no infinite-set or arbitrary inverse-semigroup extension.

value.rationale: A complete structural theorem for the centre of the full nonempty power monoid of the canonical symmetric inverse monoid for every degree \(n\): explicit elements and product, exact centre and idempotent counts, and a sharp universal power-stabilization identity. The centre has non-idempotent elements but all subgroups are trivial, a distinctive and reusable structural feature. The invariant is intrinsic and naturally motivated by the current power-semigroup rigidity literature; no arbitrary isolated numerical slice is involved.
